request.question: Find transfers sent directly from accounts owned by Alice to blocked accounts owned by companies, between 2020-01-01 00:00:00.000 and 2020-01-04 00:00:00.000 inclusive. Sum the transfer amounts for each destination account and its owning company, counting parallel transfers separately. Return all rows with company_id and account_id as their business IDs and total_amount as the sum. Sort by total_amount descending, then company_id and account_id ascending.

control.description: Entity type and identity stubs plus control attributes. No relationship edges or graph profile fields.

graph.description: Entity types, business IDs, profile attributes and all stored directed edges; no control attributes.

source_schema.identity_semantics: Canonical node identity joins across stores; id is a raw string business ID, not canonical identity.

scalar_semantics.createTime: calendar string YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm; order with timestamp_ms
scalar_semantics.missing_fields: Missing nullable properties return null; no implicit lookup in another source.
scalar_semantics.parallel_edges: Each edge has a separate canonical identity, even for equal endpoints and values.
